manifest.method: token_delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per minimal pair (english arm = the construct's own declared slot meaning applied in context; both arms carry the same facts), mean over 5 pairs; value = FLOOR across tokenizer lineages (worst tokenizer, least savings).
